description:
Which coins one trader cohort is most long and most short on, ranked across
every market: "What are the most profitable traders most bullish and most
bearish on?" Each coin has the cohort's long and short notional, net USD,
share long and wallet count, plus the cohort's overall lean across all markets
to compare against. Uses 2 API calls without a side.

cohort.description: By all-time PnL: Highly Profitable (over $100k) down to Highly Unprofitable (under -$100k). By account size: Whale (over $1M) down to Micro (under $250).
cohort.title: Cohort

min_notional_usd.description: Skip coins where the cohort holds less than this, long plus short. Without a floor a ratio ranking is all tiny markets where a few wallets are 100% one way
min_notional_usd.title: Min Notional Usd

rank_by.description: ratio: by the share of the cohort's notional that is long (conviction). net: by long minus short USD (the biggest bets, which favours BTC and ETH)
rank_by.title: Rank By

side.description: long: the coins the cohort is most bullish on; short: most bearish on. Omit for both
side.title: Side

title: Cohort top coins
